name: revenuecat
description: Build in-app subscriptions with RevenueCat: SDKs, webhooks, REST API, and the official RevenueCat MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Ship in-app subscriptions: iOS, Android, backend webhooks, and project setup.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to RevenueCat's official MCP server (mcp.revenuecat.ai) and packs four skills for subscription work: StoreKit 2 purchase and entitlement flows on iOS, Play Billing integration and plan changes on Android, server-side webhooks and REST API patterns, and project setup (API keys, products, entitlements, offerings). Built for developers wiring up subscription infrastructure, not for moving money.
defaultPrompt: Wire up RevenueCat entitlement checks in my SwiftUI paywall
Handle RevenueCat RENEWAL and BILLING_ISSUE webhooks and sync my database
Set up products, entitlements, and a default offering for my new app
